nodes.label: Karl Unit Test Suite (tests/)
nodes.rationale: Holds lexer, parser and interpreter tests (lexer_test.go, parser_test.go, basic_expressions_test.go, object_disambiguation_test.go, parser_errors_test.go, interpreter_eval_test.go); new tests stay small and assert AST shape or evaluated value. Run with `go test ./...`, or GOCACHE=$(pwd)/.go-cache when the build cache is locked.

nodes.label: examples_test.go (parses all example programs)
nodes.rationale: Full-file feature fixtures live as .k files under examples/ and this test guarantees they all keep parsing, making examples/ a de facto regression corpus.

nodes.label: object_disambiguation_test.go (block vs object literal)
nodes.rationale: Karl reuses braces for both blocks and object literals, so the disambiguation rules get their own dedicated test file.
